purpose: Distinguish logical Metal allocation reduction from process footprint accounting after WS34 failed the footprint gate. No optimization promotion or performance decision.
source: Frozen WS34 seed. OFF vs ON retains only lazy-retirement/cached-metadata policy differences. New diagnostic API/runtime instrumentation identical in both.
method: At each of8realWorldSense model-call boundaries collect globally deduplicated native graph+all-session buffer identities/roles, native device/task snapshots, and OS vmmap-summary/footprint-byte-category outputs while the native request waits for an observer acknowledgement. Original video frame/Skill/prompts/config/weights remain. Native inference/image path unchanged.
observation: Separate CPython controller thread runs only OS tools and stores metadata; no Python inference or image preparation. Validate launchd target PID and process birth identity before every capture; bounded tool timeouts, native ack timeout and explicit failure retention. No arbitrary process inspection or memory contents.
validation: New API duplicate graph/session dedup, old-single-session parity, invalid object rejection, unchanged host/private values and actual trained layer fixtures; existing native references. Real WorldSense all8tokens/text/prompt/config/image/Skill and interpreted semantics match WS10 golden.
limits: OS categories and global logical owner totals do not map exact physical pages to individual buffers. Native graph/session inventory omits driver/context scratch. OS suspension, inventory allocations and barrier waits invalidate all timing/performance claims. Memory categories are observations, not a causal effect estimate. Fresh workers; no inference retries for favorable memory.
restoration: Restore WS10 normal service/four video files/no camera/benchmarkPOST404 after observation. Preserve all raw outputs, failures, source/build/runtime/model/request identities and decision.
